column3: Settled just behind front group - third turning halfway - driven up to challenge inside final furlong - hit front and drifted left in closing stages - asserted for cosy win

Sat behind the front group early - 5th at halfway - driven when denied room a furlong out - 4th after edging right entering the final furlong - moved into 2nd inside the last 110 yards but couldn't threaten - held on same effort to the line

Knocked about and bumped at the outset - settled last of the group - asked for effort but boxed in and checked with a furlong left - sixth turning for home - driven out to finish strongest - third at the line
Sat close to the pace early - driven approaching 2f out - held 3rd and unable to threaten in the closing stages - bumped lightly and unable to find more - finished fourth

Went forward early from wide - moved over to the inner after the first furlong - driven approaching the final furlong - lost the advantage and drifted left inside the final 110 yards - held finishing effort well down the field
Sat close to the pace on the rail - fourth turning halfway - pushed along a furlong out but unable to close - finished sixth beaten 3.5 lengths
Held up in midfield near rail - blocked for room two out - pushed along and found a bit of progress inside final furlong but boxed in once more then allowed to idle close home
Settled midfield - driven approaching final furlong without threatening - dropped away late - finished eighth
Held up at the back throughout - fighting for control early - urged forward with 2f left - driven with 1f to go - faded to finish ninth
Held up at the back throughout - urged into effort 2f out - shifted right approaching final furlong but made no headway - dropped away late to finish tenth
Sluggish start - trailed the field throughout with no impact - pushed along wide at halfway before fading late

Settled just off the pace early - up to 4th by halfway - into 3rd with 4f remaining - shared the front spot 3f out - edged ahead 2f out under pressure - pulled well away inside the final furlong for an easy win
Sat close up early - dropped to 5th by halfway - urged into 3rd 2f out with little response over 1f out - stayed on same rhythm to the line - up into 2nd late but never a threat to winner
Sat handy early on eager rein - hit front after 4f - challenged 3f out - shaken up and edged out by a whisker 2f out - unable to fight back inside final furlong - held on for third but weakening late
Sat close to the pace early - up to 2nd after 5f - dropped to 3rd with 3f left and asked for effort - down to 5th under pressure inside final furlong - held on for 4th without finding more
Hesitant start and settled last - 6th at halfway - improved into 3rd 2f out under pressure - 4th approaching the final furlong - lost place late finishing 5th
Settled just off the pace early - slipped to the back by halfway - unable to land a blow from 3f out and faded late
Sent forward early on eager terms - lost command after 4f and slipped to 3rd - pushed along in 4th with 4f left - dropped away steadily - finished well beaten
Quick away and straight to front - driven approaching final furlong and edged left inside it - stayed on strongly to score
Sat second early and stayed there - asked for effort 2f out but couldn't close on the front-runner - stayed on same gear to finish second

Settled handy on the rail early - fighting for head - 7th at halfway - urged into 5th with 2f left - up to 3rd a furlong out - driven in final stretch without gaining further - stayed on same gear to finish third
Sat handy on front group early - fighting for its head - 5th at halfway - driven into 3rd two out - asked for more in 4th final furlong but couldn't threaten - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Settled in the pack early - pulling hard for a spell - pressed for effort with 2f left - held 5th spot inside the final furlong and unable to find more
Sluggish start - held up at back throughout - pushed along with 2f left - held on for sixth beaten well over 13 lengths
Sat just behind front group early - 4th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out - dropped to 6th and lost place late
Settled in the pack towards the outside pulling hard - 6th at halfway - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away to finish well beaten
Sat close to the pace wide - third at halfway - pushed along over 2f out and dropped away to finish 9th
Stood up and drifted left leaving stalls - settled at the back and stayed there - pushed along with 2f left - lost more ground to finish tenth
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along a furlong out and moved into second - hit the front inside the final 110yds - kept going to score
Fought for control early - hit front and set pace - pressed for effort a furlong out - overtaken close home and unable to reel in winner
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along into third inside the final furlong - stayed on at one gait to finish third
Settled in the pack - pushed along inside final furlong and kept on well - grabbed fourth close home
Settled in the pack - pushed along a furlong out - found a bit of headway - unable to quicken inside final 110 yards and held for fifth
Settled at the back - pushed along from 1f out and picked up ground on tiring horses late - always too far off the pace to threaten
Settled at back of field - pushed along inside final furlong - unable to close - beaten into 7th
Held up close to the pace - pushed along with a furlong left - dropped away late to finish eighth
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort 2f out - soon weakened - finished well held
Settled at the back early - lost touch approaching final furlongs - well beaten at the finish in 10th
Held up towards back of pack - driven into contention early in straight and worked through to third inside final furlong - driven out to hit front near finish
Sat behind pace - third at halfway - driven forward to hit front approaching final two furlongs - battled on gamely but caught close home
Held up in the pack - made progress on the rail entering the straight and moved into 2nd a furlong out - stayed on but unable to trouble the front two late - third
Dwelt at the off and settled last - urged into contention wide with 2f left and worked hard passing 1f marker in 9th - finished strongly to snatch 4th near the line
Held a midfield position early - driven into contention entering the straight to sit third a furlong out - stayed on at one speed to finish 5th beaten 1¾ lengths
Held up in the pack - improved into straight and up to 10th a furlong out under a drive - stayed on to finish 6th beaten 2 lengths
Held up towards the back - urged forward and made progress with a furlong left - driven and finished strongly to the line - eventually seventh beaten 2¼ lengths

Settled around midfield - driven into contention approaching 2f out then 7th and asked for more with a furlong left - unable to threaten leaders and stayed on same rate to finish 8th beaten 3.5 lengths
Held up towards the back - driven and made progress approaching 2f out - stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong - finished 9th
Sat close to the front group - 6th at halfway - driven approaching the straight but unable to find more inside final furlong and a half
Held up in the pack - driven from inside final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish - well held in 11th
Sat behind front pack early - 5th at halfway - urged into effort entering straight - faded over 1f out and held on for 12th
Settled in the middle of the pack - niggled forward into the straight but unable to land a blow from 1f out - flattened out inside the final furlong to finish 13th
Sat close to pace early - disputing 2nd at halfway - urged into straight - slipped back to 5th final furlong and held no more late
Set the pace early - overtaken approaching 2f out then lost more ground - down to 8th with a furlong left and faded to finish 15th
Sat close to front group early - 4th at halfway - urged for effort turning in - dropped away inside final 2f and finished 16th well held
Sluggish to break - settled at the back of the field - pushed along with no headway inside last two furlongs - well held at the finish
Sat close to the front rank early - 7th at halfway - found little in the straight and slipped backwards a furlong and a half out then allowed to finish in own time
Tracked the pace early - went in front after 2f - pressed for effort 2f out - drifted left and headed inside final furlong - rallied to regain command near the line

Settled just behind the front group - fighting for a strong hold - 5th at halfway - pushed along and made ground wide 2f out - into 2nd and level for the advantage a furlong out - stayed on gamely before losing out close home
Sat behind front group early - 4th at halfway - angled left and asked for effort 2f out - into 3rd but unable to close entering final furlong - held on for third
Sat close up early - settled just behind pace-setter from 2f in - pushed along in 3rd approaching 2f out - dropped to 5th with a furlong left and held for 4th
Held a handy spot on the wide side early - fighting for head early - dropped towards the back 4f out under pressure - unable to threaten leaders 2f out and stayed on same rate to the line
Settled behind the front pack pulling hard early - up to 3rd by halfway - pushed into 2nd over 2f out - dropped back to 3rd inside the final furlong - unable to find more late and finished 6th
Sluggish start - settled midfield travelling keenly - urged forward approaching 2f out - drifted left under pressure inside final furlong and held no more in reserve
Held up at the back throughout - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to find more and beaten home eighth
Settled at back of field early - shaken up passing halfway mark - under pressure with 2f left - lost place late to finish ninth well beaten
Settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out and dropped away
Pulling hard early - sat second - driven approaching final furlong to hit front - stayed on for the win
Sat third early - pushed along entering the last furlong to move into second - stayed on to the line but no match for winner
Settled at the rear - pushed along inside final furlong - moved up into third close home
Sent clear early - under pressure and lost front spot inside final furlong - dropped away close home
Set the pace from the off - urged on approaching 2f out and again inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to win
Close to the front early - urged forward approaching 3f out - lost ground for a spell 2f out - rallied steadily inside the final furlong - stayed on well to snatch second near the line
Prominent early - moved into second three furlongs out - stayed on terms with the pacesetter a furlong out - pressed for effort but couldn't quicken - dropped away near the line to finish third
Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back of the pack - short of a gap approaching the final 2f - squeezed for room a furlong out - angled right and came on strongly to be fourth
Settled at the back early - urged into contention over 2f out - moved left and made ground under a furlong left - stayed on but never reached the front rank
Settled in the pack early - pushed to close in on the front group over 2f out - unable to make further gains in the final furlong - dropped away towards the line to finish 6th
Settled off the pace early - pressed for effort from 3f out - eased back through the field late to finish 7th
Settled in the pack - pushed along and shifted wide with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong
Handy early - dropped away with pressure applied over 3f out - faded rapidly from 2f out - finished 9th
Raced up with the front group from a wide berth - pushed along and slipped back around 4f out - faded into the pack and toiling from 2f out home
Settled at back of field - began weakening 3f out - dropped away with 2f left - well beaten at finish
Settled midpack early - moved up on the near flank from 2f out - hit the front approaching final furlong and quickly opened daylight - stayed on strongly to score comfortably
Settled in third early - pulled left under pressure as bid for the front over 1f out - collared inside the final furlong and faded - clung on for second in the dying strides
Settled at the back - progress from 2f out - moved into third and up with the front pair inside the final furlong - found little late
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along to improve wide of rivals inside the final two furlongs - up into fourth close home - stayed on to the line
Held up towards back of pack - improving position before contact with another runner inside final furlong - stayed on to finish fifth
Settled in second early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish sixth
Handy with front group early - shifted across approaching 2f out then lost ground and knocked off stride inside final furlong - dropped away close home to finish seventh
Sluggish start - settled at the back - pushed along to close ground wide from 2f out - stayed on to finish eighth
Sat no closer than mid-pack from the off - drifted off a straight line for the whole trip - well held at the finish
Held up towards back - pushed along to close a little inside final furlong - stayed on to finish 10th
Handy early with front group - driven approaching 3f out then drifted right inside final furlong - lost place and dropped away close home to finish 11th
Held up at back of field - dropped further away entering final furlong - beaten before the line - finished well held in 12th
Bowled along in front - pressed hard and collared 2f out - dropped away sharply into the final furlong to finish 13th
Handy early - faded through the pack and went wide 4f out - beaten last before the final furlong to finish well held
Settled in the pack early - up to 4th at halfway then 3rd turning for home under a drive - asked for more a furlong out - responded strongly close home to hit the front and score

Sat behind front group early - still second at halfway - urged forward to join front rank inside final two furlongs - hit front early in last furlong and battled on gamely - caught close home to finish second by a short margin
Sat close behind front group - 5th at halfway - driven approaching straight and asked for effort with a furlong left - finished strongly to be third
Settled towards the back of the pack - improved position entering the straight and up to 7th with a furlong left - pushed out and finished strongly to take 4th
Held front spot early - driven on straight and drawn level then overtaken inside final furlong - held on final stretch to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - improved on the rails approaching 2f out - 10th with a furlong left - pushed out and finished strongly to take 6th
Sat close to front group early - 6th at halfway - urged into contention entering straight - unable to gain over 1f out and stayed on same effort to finish 7th
Held a midfield position - driven approaching straight with little response over a furlong out - stayed on at one gait late to finish eighth
Held up in the pack - driven and outpaced turning for home - stayed on to finish 9th
Sat close to the front pack early - 8th at halfway - driven approaching the straight but unable to gain ground over a furlong out and stayed on at one speed
Close behind pace early - 3rd at halfway - urged into contention 2f out to share front spot - overtaken 1f out and held no more in reserve to finish 11th
Sat close to the pace early then settled midfield by halfway - asked for effort into the straight - 9th and driven a furlong out but unable to find more - well held at the finish
Sat close to the front group early - 7th at halfway - driven approaching straight and unable to find more inside final furlong
Held up in midfield - urged into contention entering straight - driven approaching final furlong - unable to find more close home - finished 14th beaten 4 lengths
Held up towards the back of the field - failed to land a blow throughout - no response when asked early in the straight and finished well held
Held up at back early - still towards the back at halfway - pushed along on the straight and unable to quicken from 1f out - finished 16th
Held up in the pack - urged wide turning for home - driven with 1f left and unable to quicken inside final furlong - well held in 17th
Settled in the pack - driven approaching straight without threatening leaders - unable to find more - well held at finish
Towards the back of the pack throughout - made no headway when driven in the home straight - faded to finish 19th
Held up at the back throughout - pushed along early in the straight with no headway made - unable to quicken and well held at the finish
Settled at the back - made no headway when roused entering the straight - well held in 21st
Settled just off front rank - third at halfway - driven to the front two out - stayed on strongly to score
Sluggish start - settled handy on the rail - going nicely 2f out - shifted right and asked for effort in 3rd inside final furlong - couldn't close on the leader - stayed on same gear to finish second
Sat behind front-runner on rail - hit the front at halfway - driven and lost the advantage 2f out - third early in the final furlong unable to close - stayed on same gear to finish third
Held up at the back and driven early - still in 7th under pressure a furlong out and unable to threaten - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Sat handy behind front pack - angled right and driven on 2f out - held 4th but couldn't find more late
Held up at the back and driven early - boxed in with no headway a furlong out - shifted right approaching the final furlong but couldn't find more
Held up at back - urged forward early then reached midfield with a furlong left - unable to find more late on - finished seventh
Set the pace early - lost the advantage at halfway - urged along and dropped away over the final furlong
Sat close to the pace on the wide side - pushed along 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - eventually well held
Settled midpack early - urged forward to reach second inside final furlong - hit the front with 110yds left - challenged again but held on for the win
Handy early - hit front two out - driven approaching final furlong - lost advantage inside final 110yds and fought back but not quite denied
Held up in the pack - pushed along and closed 1f out - moved into third and kept going to finish
Settled in the pack - boxed in with 2f left before finding space and pushed along inside final furlong - came through late to take fourth
Sat close to front group early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground final furlong to finish 5th
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - made no impact on finish
Settled towards the back - pushed along with two furlongs remaining - unable to land a blow - finished seventh
Set the early pace - driven up as rivals went by inside the final two furlongs - dropped away quickly after - well held at the finish
Set the pace from the off - opened up a handy advantage over 2f out - pushed along inside the final 2f - stayed on strongly to the line for the win
Tracked the pace - moved into second 2f out - kept on inside final furlong but unable to trouble the winner - beaten into 2nd
Sluggish start - settled towards back - asked for effort with 2f left - gained ground gradually but couldn't reach front pair - moved into third inside final furlong - stayed on to finish third
Fretting before the off - stumbled start - settled mid-pack - pushed to chase 2f out - moved into third with a furlong left but couldn't get near leading pair and edged out of the frame close home
Held a leading spot early - pressed for effort but slipped back over 2f out - faded to finish fifth
Settled towards the back - urged forward with 3f left - lost touch under pressure 2f out and faded to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - pushed for effort with 3f left - lost ground under pressure inside final 2f to finish well held
Held handy racing wide - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong
Settled towards the back of the pack - lost touch four out - toiling from three furlongs out - beaten before the finish
Settled in the pack early - moved through from 2f out - hit the front inside the final furlong - powered clear near the line to win comfortably
Close to pace early - hit front a furlong out under pressure - overtaken close home and unable to find more
Settled towards the back - improved through the middle of the track inside the final furlong - pushed along to move into third - unable to find more close home
Settled towards the back early - made ground from a furlong out - closed on the front group inside the final furlong - stayed on to grab fourth close home
Handy with the front group early - short of room on several occasions from 2f out - faded inside final furlong to finish 5th
Held a forward spot early - driven and dropped back a furlong out - faded fast in the closing stages to finish sixth
Held up in the pack - pushed along a furlong out - gave way close home - finished seventh
Settled in the pack - driven on with three furlongs left - stayed on at a steady effort late to finish eighth
Held up at the back - lost touch from 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 9th
Settled just behind the leader early - asked for effort with 3f left then gave way - dropped through the field to finish well beaten
Set the pace early - pushed along when overtaken approaching 2f out and lost ground fast - trailed off before the line
Settled midpack - 5th at halfway - driven and angled right approaching 2f out - moved into 2nd and drifted left inside the final furlong - got up close home to prevail
Settled at the back - niggled into contention down the straight - moved into 3rd in the final 100 yards and stayed on strongly - beaten a short head
Settled behind front group - third turning halfway - driven into command approaching final furlong while drifting left - overtaken close home - held on grimly for third
Sluggish start and driven up early - sat behind front group and 4th at halfway - down to 6th and urged over 1f out - stayed on same gait late to finish 4th
Settled towards the back early - improved position entering straight - driven through to third a furlong out but checked in run - unable to find more late finishing 5th beaten 2.75L
Settled towards the back of the field - 6th at halfway - driven approaching the straight with little response inside the final two furlongs - stayed on same gear to finish sixth
Sat close to pace and second by halfway - driven up to dispute lead approaching 2f out - checked in traffic entering final furlong and held on for 4th before finishing 7th

Driven on to strike the front early - held a two length advantage by halfway - urged again entering the straight - overtaken a furlong out and knocked back sharply soon after in traffic - lost touch late to finish eighth
Handy early behind pace - angled right over 2f out - pushed along inside final furlong - hit front close home and pulled clear
Settled behind front group - improved to hit front over 1f out - challenged inside final furlong - overtaken close home - narrowly missed out for the win
Settled towards back early - improved and pressed on inside final 2f - powered home last furlong - closing best at line
Settled in the pack - began to move up passing the furlong marker and angled left inside the final furlong - finished strongly for 4th
Handy early - hit front over 2f out before losing advantage inside final furlong - stayed on to finish fifth
Drifted right at the break - settled in the pack - progress to challenge 2f out - short of room on multiple occasions inside the final furlong and stayed on into 6th
Poor start - settled towards back before angling right approaching final furlong - stayed on in closing stages to finish 7th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along inside the last furlong and drifted left - weakened near the finish to end up 8th
Settled towards back early - improved and pushed along a furlong out - unable to find more inside final 110yds finishing 9th
Settled midpack early - driven for effort when drifting right approaching 2f out - lost place inside final furlong - eventually finished tenth beaten just over eight lengths
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost command inside final two furlongs - dropped away quickly after finishing 11th
Sluggish start - settled midfield - knocked off course to the right approaching 2f out - faded final furlong to finish well beaten

Shared front spot early - went on after a furlong and a half and set the pace throughout - asked for effort 2f out - clear by two lengths approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly for an easy win

Shared front spot early - gave way after a furlong and a half then sat second - urged into third around 2f out - couldn't threaten with a furlong left - regained second close home to finish second under pressure
Sat just behind front group on inside - 4th at halfway - shifted left and asked for effort over 2f out but found little - stayed on same gear to finish third
Held up at the back - still 7th at halfway - urged into 6th with 2f left - chasing in 5th approaching final furlong but unable to close - stayed on same gait to finish 4th

Sat handy behind the front group going keenly - third and lost footing a touch turning in - into second and driven over 2f out - unable to make further headway with a furlong left - held late to finish fifth
Settled just off the pace pulling hard - 6th at halfway - pushed along 2f out - unable to find more and beaten well home

Dwelt at the start - dropped away tamely and well adrift in the field - showed inexperience through the early stages - 8th 2f out and plugged on at one tempo - no impression on the principals to finish 7th
Slow to start - settled at the back and soon adrift - urged and looked inexperienced early - asked for effort 2f out and faded
Sluggish start - shifted right to settle on rail - close up and pulling hard early - 5th at halfway - asked for effort 2f out then dropped away
Settled with eager keenness early - tracked pace in the leading group - hit the front two out - pushed along and stayed on strongly to win
Pulled hard early tracking pace - pressed into contention 2f out - improved into second inside final furlong - stayed on to finish second beaten 1¾ lengths
Pulled hard early - up with the front group - pushed along inside the final furlong - plugged on at one speed to finish third
Settled towards the middle of the pack after covering extra ground early - driven into third spot 2f out - faded inside the final furlong - finished fourth
Settled in the pack - pushed along a furlong out and edged forward - flattened out close home to finish 5th
Settled towards the back - urged into contention over 2f out - unable to land a blow - finished sixth
Set the pace early - driven up front approaching 2f out then lost the advantage - dropped away fast inside final furlong - eventually well held in 7th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and dropped away 3f out - trailed home never a factor - finished eighth
Settled at the back - niggled along 2f out - quickly found wanting and allowed to coast home 9th

Held up at back - moved left before 1f - within range of front group 3f out - travelling nicely 2f out - made smooth progress over 1f out - shifted right and up to second inside final furlong - driven to front close home - stayed on strongly to prevail
Settled behind pace - moved into second 2f out - pushed into front over 1f out - overtaken and unable to quicken close home
Settled at the back early - much to find approaching final furlong - made smooth progress and angled right - stayed on well inside the last - up into third close home
Sent clear early - pushed along 2f out then lost the advantage inside the final furlong - dropped away late to finish fourth
Settled with the pack early - pushed for effort inside final 3f and again 2f out - unable to threaten and finished held for 5th
Tracked front pack early - urged forward wide 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish sixth
Wide and towards the back of the pack early - lost more ground into last with 4f left and toiling by 3f out - well held from 2f out to finish seventh
Settled handily early despite fighting for control - up with the pace - pushed for effort inside final furlong and faded fast to finish well beaten
Sat close up early - disputed second at halfway - pushed along to hit front a furlong out and stayed on strongly to the line

Went straight to front and opened two lengths by halfway - driven into the straight then overtaken with a furlong left - asked for more but couldn't match winner close home - stayed on at same rate for second
Settled in the pack early - up to 5th at halfway then 3rd turning in - driven approaching final furlong but held to finish third

Hesitant start needing urging - up with the front group and 4th at halfway - dropped to 5th and urged early in the straight - back to 4th under pressure a furlong out and stayed on same effort to finish
Held up in the pack - driven approaching final 2f without threatening - stayed on same speed to finish 5th
Sat behind front group early - 3rd at halfway - 4th and driven on entering straight - unable to close and held on for 6th
Held up towards the back - eased and pulled up soon after entering the straight
Settled towards the back early - going smoothly but needed a gap approaching the furlong marker - found space inside the final 110 yards and asserted for an easy success
Went straight to front - pressed for effort when overtaken 2f out and again inside final furlong - fought back well to grab second close home
Handy early with front group - moved through to hit front a furlong out but overtaken close home - unable to find more and held for third by a short head
Missed the break - settled at the back - asked for effort with a furlong left - responded well late to snatch fourth close home
Handy early - hit front two out before being overtaken and driven approaching final furlong - lost ground close home to finish fifth
Settled at back early - improved into contention over 2f out - eased back in final furlong to finish sixth
Checked shortly after the break - settled in the pack - asked for effort inside the final furlong - faded to finish 7th
Held a share of the pack early - travelled wide of rivals - lost touch a furlong out - came away untroubled late to finish eighth
Settled off the pace early - eased forward and going strongly with over a furlong left - pushed into the front inside the final furlong - kept finding more to the line - won
Settled in mid-pack early - shifted to find space a furlong out - stayed on strongly once in the open - closed to snatch second near the line
Settled in the pack - progress under a furlong out and closed strongly to press for the front spots inside the last - edged out of second close home
Settled towards the back - improved approaching final furlong - driven and stayed on to finish fourth
Tracked leading group early - pushed along 2f out and closed in to press for lead 1f out - couldn't find more inside final furlong - finished fifth
Tracked the pace-setters - hit the front for a stride entering the last furlong - then flattened out to finish sixth beaten 4 lengths
settled towards the back - made progress and pushed along a furlong out - unable to find more inside final 110yds finishing seventh
Pulling hard early - settled midfield - pressed into effort a furlong out - stayed on same speed to finish eighth
Held up handy early - hit front approaching 2f out then lost advantage inside final furlong - faded close home to finish ninth
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - gave way in the final furlong to finish 10th
Sent forward early - hit the front and set the pace before being collared with 2f left - dropped away final furlong
Poor start - settled towards back of the field - drifted left final furlong with no impact on finish
Settled in the pack - unable to improve position - well held at the finish
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished well held
Fought for control early - up behind the front pack then pressed for effort 2f out - lost place inside final furlong to finish well held
Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away quickly - well held at the finish
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost momentum and boxed in a furlong out - well held at the line
Settled just behind the pace on the rail - 5th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left - angled left into 3rd inside final furlong - hit the front 110 yards out and stayed on strongly for the win
Sat close to pacesetter early - driven up to share front spot 2f out - hit the front inside final furlong - overtaken close home - unable to reassert but stayed on same gear to the line
Set the pace early - driven and pegged back approaching 2f out - lost front spot inside final furlong and dropped to 3rd - held that spot to the line without finding more

Stood up and hesitant leaving stalls - settled last and pulling hard - up to 6th by the midpoint - boxed in with two out - pushed along into 4th a furlong out - unable to threaten leaders and stayed on same rate to finish fourth
Sat behind front group early - 3rd at halfway - driven approaching 2f out - held 5th and unable to find more
Settled just behind the pace - driven approaching 3f out and up into 7th with 2f left - unable to find more late
Sat handy behind pace and travelled keenly - 4th at halfway - pressed for effort 2f out - lost place inside final furlong to finish 7th
Sluggish start - trailed the pack throughout with no impact - pushed along 2f out and dropped away late
Sent clear from the start - lost the advantage after a furlong but stayed close up - pushed along with a furlong left - regained command inside the final 110yds - kept finding to score
Settled in the pack early - pushed into third approaching final furlong - closed to be second at the line
Settled in the pack early - hit the front three out - pushed along a furlong out - overtaken close home and edged out for second in the final strides
Settled just behind leaders - pushed along a furlong out - found extra late but lacked the speed to get involved - finished four lengths back in 4th
